text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, shortly before Valentine's<n>Day...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmm-hm-hmmm! ♪ Chocolatey<n>chocolaaate! ♪
Tasty, tasty chocolate!<n>♪ Hmm-hm-hmmm! ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heeheehee... Bwahaha...<n>KEHEHEHE!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Lackey! You here?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehehehe! Bet you weren't<n>expecting to see me
today! Gawr!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Something up? Well... uh...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I had nothin' better to do, so I'm<n>checkin' in on ya!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No! Your ears broken or something?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Anyway...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heeheehee... There we go.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: LOOK! UP THERE! A FLYING SAUCER!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Now's my chance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look out the window but don't notice<n>anything
unearthly, so I bring my<n>attention back inside.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ughhh! Errr!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You weren't supposed to look yet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy slams a box down on<n>my desk so
hard that the sides<n>crease and bend, allowing a
sweet<n>aroma to escape from within. I open<n>the lid to
find...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... GRRRRR! I was gonna play it off<n>like they just
showed up outta thin<n>air!
choice_data_list: Oh, are you giving these to me for Valentine's Day?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: URGGGHHHH! Wipe that smile off<n>your face!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: N-no! I mean...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I—uh... It's like! Uhhh! Mnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I brought 'em here to gloat!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bwahaha! Ahhhmm! Delicious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy eats one of the<n>chocolates and
flashes an arrogant<n>grin.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Jealous, aren't ya?! Windy's<n>chocolates are the
best around,<n>period!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mm-mm! That's delicious! My<n>tastebuds are
squealing with<n>chocolaty joy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Too bad you can't have any.Man, would I hate to be you...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
But if you really, really wanna have<n>some, I
suppose I could share...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling this is probably<n>another one of her
pranks. So...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh-ho? You want some, do ya?<n>Heh-heh-heh!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Guess I can be nice then and let ya<n>have the rest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pop a chocolate in my mouth. The<n>sweet flavor
washes over my tongue<n>and then... my nose?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! Gotcha!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You should see your face! It's a<n>Windy
special—karashi mustard-filled<n>chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh? I didn't think it'd be that spicy...Must've put too much in.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
But don't worry. It's just the one.<n>Hurry up and
eat another.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heeheehee... I didn't think you'd hit<n>the jackpot on
your first draw.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You're a funny one, you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The rest of the chocolates are<n>absolutely delicious.
In the end, I<n>thank Windy for the wonderful
Valentine's Day gift.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling this is probably<n>another one of her
pranks. Normally,<n>I'd willingly take the bait, but this
time...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she doesn't learn her lesson now,<n>she'll have a
lot more trouble as an<n>adult. Something tells me
going easy<n>on her won't be good in the long run.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? What gives? Don'tcha want<n>one? They're
to die for, you should<n>know!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Or, I could just devour aaaaall of 'em<n>myself...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Y-you really don't want 'em? Even<n>though I'm
going out of my way to<n>offer you a taste?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: They came out perfect, I tell ya!<n>PERFECT!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I tried my very best to make 'em<n>taste good...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: S-sniffle... Nngh...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
F-fine! Be like that! I'mma eat 'em all<n>myself,
thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: HMPH!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Whaddya want?! GRRRRR!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I seem to have crossed a line. Feeling<n>guilty, I try to
ask a question that will<n>help her open up.
choice_data_list: Were you... trying to show off your cooking skills?
Were you... trying to show off your cooking skills?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah... I was! Props for finally<n>figuring it out.
choice_data_list: So... you wanted to make me your taste tester, then!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Welp, the cat's outta the bag. Now Ihave to hand them over to you.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Now eat!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And kneel before me as you relish<n>my
chocolate-making prowess!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'll give you one! So eat and be<n>amazed!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...W-well? Tasty, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! See? What'd I tell ya? Go<n>on, dig in!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh, but don't forget to savor 'em, got<n>that?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
After all, these chocolates are special<n>'cause I
made 'em just for you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she puts on a haughty<n>facade, I can tell the
real motivation<n>behind her gift. The slightly chunky
chocolates are absolutely delicious,<n>too.
